components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:var(--background, #1e1f22);color:var(--foreground, #d7dae0);border:1px solid #4c515c;border-radius:4px;padding:7px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--color-primary, #729df3);}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:12px;}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-primary, #729df3);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Project navigation
components.description: Compact file rows with neutral selection and a source attachment action.
components.css: .ds-project{background:#25262a;color:var(--foreground, #d7dae0);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-project-row{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:25px;padding:0 5px 0 25px;}.ds-project-row:hover{background:#ffffff06;}.ds-project-selected{background:#ffffff0c;color:#e0e8f8;}.ds-project-target{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex:1;min-width:0;height:25px;padding:0 5px 0 0;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:12px;}.ds-project-target span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-project-target svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:#c8906a;flex-shrink:0;}.ds-project-attach{width:22px;height:22px;min-height:22px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:none;color:#adb3c0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;}.ds-project-row:hover .ds-project-attach,.ds-project-row:focus-within .ds-project-attach{opacity:1;}.ds-project-attach:hover{background:#ffffff0c;color:#e1e5ee;}.ds-project-target:focus-visible,.ds-project-attach:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary, #729df3);outline-offset:-2px;border-radius:3px;}

components.name: Source reference chip
components.description: Captured code reference with separate preview and remove controls.
components.css: .ds-reference{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:#2b3039;border:1px solid #495262;border-radius:5px;height:25px;max-width:100%;color:#c3cfe2;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-reference-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-width:0;padding:0 6px;height:100%;border:0;background:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:10px;}.ds-reference-label span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-reference svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex-shrink:0;}.ds-reference-remove{display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 5px 0 0;border:0;background:none;color:#a9b6cc;cursor:pointer;}.ds-reference-label:focus-visible,.ds-reference-remove:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary, #729df3);outline-offset:-2px;border-radius:3px;}.ds-reference.ds-reference-stale{border-color:#a68c54;}

components.name: Chat composer
components.description: Single compact toolbar with context, model, effort, fixed Auto-review status, and Send.
components.css: .ds-composer{border:1px solid #474c56;border-radius:6px;background:#25272c;color:var(--foreground, #d7dae0);overflow:hidden;transition:border-color 120ms;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:#718ebd;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #5473a31a;}.ds-composer textarea{width:100%;display:block;background:none;border:0;outline:0;padding:12px 11px 5px;resize:none;min-height:66px;max-height:240px;color:inherit;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;caret-color:#9dc0ff;}.ds-composer textarea::placeholder{color:#a4acba;}.ds-composer-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:3px 5px 5px;min-height:32px;}.ds-composer-spacer{flex:1;}.ds-composer-icon,.ds-composer-model,.ds-composer-effort,.ds-composer-send{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:27px;height:27px;min-height:27px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:none;cursor:pointer;}.ds-composer-icon{color:#adb3c0;font-size:16px;}.ds-composer-model{color:#c9d0dd;}.ds-composer-effort{color:#aab2c0;}.ds-composer-icon:hover:not(:disabled){background:#ffffff0c;color:#e1e5ee;}.ds-composer-model:hover:not(:disabled),.ds-composer-effort:hover:not(:disabled){background:#ffffff09;}.ds-review-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:27px;height:27px;color:#acb9aa;}.ds-review-status svg{width:12px;height:12px;}.ds-composer-send{border-radius:5px;background:var(--color-primary, #729df3);color:#15213a;transition:background-color 120ms,color 120ms;}.ds-composer-send:hover:not(:disabled){background:#8eb1f7;}.ds-composer-toolbar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary, #729df3);outline-offset:-2px;border-radius:3px;}.ds-composer-toolbar button:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default;}

components.css: .ds-dialog{width:min(640px,90vw);max-height:85vh;overflow:auto;background:#292c32;border:1px solid #535b69;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 15px 55px #0008;padding:20px;color:var(--foreground, #d7dae0);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-dialog h2{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 7px;font-weight:550;color:#dce5f4;}.ds-dialog p{font-size:12px;color:#aebbd0;line-height:1.7;margin:0;}.ds-dialog-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:18px;}.ds-dialog-close{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:29px;padding:5px 11px;border:0;border-radius:5px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms,color 120ms;background:#34373f;color:#dce0e9;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #474b56;}.ds-dialog-close:hover:not(:disabled){background:#414650;}.ds-dialog-close:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-primary, #729df3);outline-offset:-2px;border-radius:3px;}.ds-dialog-close:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default;}

narrative.overview:
A compact desktop IDE keeps source code central. Graphite surfaces, quiet dividers, system labels, and readable monospace code follow the accepted JetBrains and early Cursor references. Codex sits beside the editor as a companion.

The current compact layout removes repeated workspace labels and chat onboarding. Most controls use small line icons with tooltips; menus retain full labels. Density comes from slim chrome and closed tools, while source text keeps its own readable scale.
keyCharacteristics: Source code gets the flexible center column.
Docked panes use tonal separation and thin dividers.
Blue marks actions, selection, and keyboard focus.
Compact icons keep labels available through tooltips and menus.

rules.name: The State Accent Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actions, current selection, and focus. Use status colors to explain state.

rules.name: The Readable Code Rule
rules.body: Compact chrome does not shrink source text. Keep the editor at its configured size, with a default of 13px.

rules.name: The Docked Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep docked panes flat. Use shadows to separate floating menus, tooltips, dialogs, and notices.

dos: Do keep Project and Codex docked at startup, with bottom tools collapsed.
Do reveal tool windows when navigation or a user action needs them.
Do use the existing line icons, quiet borders, and short sentence case labels.
Do name icon controls with accessible labels and tooltips.
Do keep model and reasoning choices in labelled menus and show Auto-review as fixed status.
Do preserve keyboard focus and source reference actions in compact views.
donts: Don't add Ask/Edit modes or an approval-policy picker.
Don't restore repeated workspace titles or chat onboarding to the working surface.
Don't turn docked panes into floating cards or add decorative shadows.
Don't reduce the editor font to make chrome fit.
Don't treat macOS capture indicators or browser-preview labels as native product branding.
